programmes.t: Teen Mom 2: Half Empty Half Full
programmes.d: Leah plans a 2nd birthday party for the girls, Chelsea convinces her dad to help her move, Kieffer comes crashing back into Jenelle's life, and Kailyn meets a cute new boy named Javi. (S3, ep10)
Catelynn and Tyler face a setback with the new house, Farrah and Debra continue to feud, Amber steps in to help Gary and Kristina, and bride-to-be Maci hosts a family dinner.
Leah and Jeremy get serious, while Chelsea breaks down on Adam's birthday. Jenelle questions if Andrew is really Jace's, while Kailyn is asked out on a date. (S3, ep11)
Amber undergoes plastic surgery in an attempt to relieve her negative self-image issues, while Farrah and her mum try to reconcile their differences after an awkward encounter.

programmes.t: Teen Mom 2: A Means To An End
programmes.d: Leah has some big news for Corey, while Chelsea gets ready for beauty school. Jenelle goes through with the paternity test while Kailyn and Jo get into a huge fight over his new girlfriend. (S3, ep12)
Farrah is wary of Debra as she opens her third store, Tyler reflects on his emotional state, Maci celebrates Halloween with her extended family, and Amber is hurt by Gary's lack of trust.
Dr Drew hosts a look back at the hilarious highs and the difficult lows never before seen with Kailyn, Leah, Jenelle and Chelsea from the third season of Teen Mom 2.
Bentley celebrates his eighth birthday with family, Farrah hires a nanny, Amber and Gary try to find common ground, and Tyler and Catelynn wonder how best to support Butch after his relapse.

programmes.t: Teen Mom UK: Next Generation: New Highs
programmes.d: Matt and Angel welcome a new member to the family! Jack makes a big promise to Chloe and E-H. Whitney and Elizabeth seal their bond. Isha and Jamie's relationship hits new highs and lows.
Amber and Catelynn celebrate their daughters' birthdays as Tyler dreams of a son, Farrah decides to bid farewell to Texas, and Ryan is angered by Maci's Thanksgiving plans for Bentley.

programmes.t: Teen Mom UK: Next Generation: Let Down
programmes.d: Angels left holding the baby while her boyfriend is down the pub. Whitney is 37 weeks pregnant! Chloe feels broken, Isha feels lonely, and Ellie is just angry!
Farrah tours San Diego with Simon's help, Catelynn and Tyler escape on a wintry weekend getaway, Amber feels left out of Leah's Christmas plans, and Ryan has a big surprise for Mackenzie.

programmes.t: Teen Mom UK: Next Generation: Under Pressure
programmes.d: Whitney is worried about falling behind. Angel and Matt are falling apart. Isha's facing up to her anxiety. Chloe's facing her attachment issues and Ellie is trying to fix her relationship.

programmes.t: Teen Mom UK: A New Chapter For Some
programmes.d: Teen Moms are back! Sassi's dreams of her future without Darren, and Mia's dreaming of an easier life with Marliya and Maggie. Amber's got her life on track, but Ste could derail things.
Amber plans a fashion show, Maci has a heart-to-heart with Mackenzie, Farrah and Debra reunite for Sophia's birthday, and Tyler and Catelynn resolve to learn from their parents' mistakes.

programmes.t: Teen Mom UK: Old Problems And New
programmes.d: Amber's problems with Ste are getting worse and Mia's worried about Marliya after she falls ill. Chloe's making sure Marley's ready to become a brother, and Sassi is chasing her dreams.
Butch seeks Dr. Drew's advice, Amber has doubts about her engagement to Matt, Mackenzie goes behind Maci's back with Ryan's parents, and Sophia meets Debra's fiance at an awkward dinner.

programmes.t: Teen Mom UK: Looking Forward or Back?
programmes.d: Chloe's in a celebratory mood as she finally has the baby shower. Sassi rolls up her sleeves, Amber's dealing with an old foe, and Mia tries to bury the hatchet with Maggie.
Catelynn and Tyler come up with a new business idea, Farrah undergoes hypnotherapy, a trip to Las Vegas causes major strife for Amber and Matt, and Maci receives disturbing news about Ryan.

programmes.t: Teen Mom UK: The Big Days
programmes.d: Amber and Ste have a final showdown. Meanwhile, Mia has a final showdown of her own with Maggie. Sassi's launching her brand new business. The big day has finally come for Chloe!
Farrah is invited to speak at South by Southwest, while the other three ladies head to Puerto Rico with their partners for some fun in the sun and much-needed girl talk.
Chloe's coming to terms with life as a mum of 2. Sassi is out in the world of dating. Mia is navigating motherhood to a teenager. Amber has a new man.
Catelynn looks for ways to help out other young moms in need, Farrah appears on a dating show, Amber is taken aback by Gary's big surprise, and Maci and Taylor try out marriage counseling.
Amber gets upset speaking to her mum about Ste's behaviour. Mia and Manley try to discuss Marliya's attitude which ends in another argument.
Nova starts preschool, Maci celebrates Taylor's birthday, Farrah takes Simon to hypnotherapy, and Matt and Amber find a wedding venue, but a press trip to NYC brings unpleasant surprises.

programmes.t: Teen Mom UK: A Welcome Break
programmes.d: Amber and Elliot take the boys on their first trip away all together. Chloe has a stressful week when both the kids are unwell.
Maci agonizes over how to confront Ryan's drug use, Farrah is annoyed by David during a family vacation, Catelynn and Tyler admire a new house, and Amber hears yet more rumors about Matt.
Mia and Manley sit down with Marliya to discuss her attitude towards them. Chloe and Jordan have a date day without the kids.

programmes.t: Teen Mom 2: Season 3 Finale Special: Check Up with Dr. Drew Part 1
programmes.d: Dr Drew hosts the Teen Moms in front of a live audience. Jenelle sits down with Jace's dad for the first time in years and Chelsea continues to hold on to Adam despite her father's frustrations.
Catelynn and Tyler work out their differences, Cheyenne disapproves of Cory's girlfriend, Maci is wary about speaking with Ryan, and Amber discusses her spat with Jenelle.

programmes.t: Teen Mom 2: Season 3 Finale Special: Check Up with Dr. Drew Part 2
programmes.d: Dr Drew hosts the Teen Moms in front of a live studio audience. Leah reveals some tragic news about her pregnancy and Kailyn struggles to accept Jo's new girlfriend.
Cory and Taylor grow closer, Maci tells Bentley about Ryan's arrest, and Cheyenne doesn't think Cory understands the complexities of Ryder's genetic disorder.
Leah faces re-emerging feelings for Corey. Jenelle and Gary spend time with Jace. Kailyn and Jo get into a physical fight. Chelsea is worried she might be pregnant again. (S4, ep1)
Catelynn gives birth, Maci and Taylor take Maverick to a speech pathologist, Amber and Andrew head to L.A., and Cheyenne is dating someone new.
Kailyn and Jo go to court. Chelsea has her first day of beauty school. Leah expresses strong feelings for Corey and Jenelle finds out that Gary had sex with her best friend. (S4, ep2)

programmes.t: Teen Mom 2: The Future is Now
programmes.d: Leah is torn between Corey and Jeremy. Adam texts Chelsea to see Aubree, but it doesn't go as planned. Jenelle finishes probation and Kailyn takes Isaac to Jo's. (S4, ep3)
Kieffer and Jenelle are dating again. Kailyn tries to take Jo to court to change their custody agreement. Chelsea tells her mum about the pregnancy scare. (S4, ep4)
Gary and Jenelle are back together and she tries to be more responsible. Kailyn has a violent outburst toward Javi. Chelsea finds out about Adam's new girlfriend and Leah plans her wedding. (S4, ep6)

programmes.t: Teen Mom 2: For Better or For Worse
programmes.d: Leah and Jeremy have a courthouse wedding. Adam tries to make Chelsea jealous. Gary has a big surprise for Jenelle. Kailyn and Javi discuss joining the military and getting married. (S4, ep7)
Gary and Jenelle get into an altercation which lands them both in jail. Chelsea talks to her lawyer about Adam's strange legal letter. Kailyn and Javi consider getting married in Las Vegas. (S4, ep8)
Leah reaches out to her biological dad and Jenelle goes to court to face the charges from the Gary fight. Javi passes his Air Force test and he and Kail seriously talk marriage. (S4, ep9)

programmes.t: Teen Mom 2: For Love and Money
programmes.d: Javi has a big surprise for Kailyn. Jenelle, Barb, and Kieffer celebrate Jace's 3rd birthday but Jenelle reveals she has some serious money problems. Chelsea celebrates her 21st birthday. (S4, ep10)
Jenelle learns that she has very little chance of getting custody of Jace. Leah takes Ali to a neuromuscular specialist and Kailyn finally tells Jo about her plans with Javi. (S4, ep11)

programmes.t: Teen Mom 2: The End of the Road
programmes.d: Barbara tries to have Jenelle committed for using drugs; Chelsea returns to beauty school; Kailyn and Javi get married; Leah's daughter endures medical tests. (S4, ep12)
